guide.COMPONENT_MATCHING_ERROR: Prediction and paint are individually plausible, but row/component association compares the wrong structures.
guide.DETECTOR_FALSE_POSITIVE: A detector line is clearly unsupported by the visible road marking. A gap between painted dashes is not a painted-mask miss automatically.
guide.DETECTOR_LOCALIZATION_ERROR: The same identifiable marking was detected, but the prediction is spatially displaced. No numerical threshold is inferred from this review.
guide.DETECTOR_MISS: A clearly visible relevant marking is not detected. All painted markings are GT, but the detector representation may target only lane boundaries; check representation first.
guide.FAR_FIELD_AMBIGUOUS: Distant/horizon geometry is not visually adjudicable. Image thirds are pixel regions, not calibrated distances.
guide.GT_EXTRA_MARKING: The GT includes additional paint types that the detector output does not represent. This is not automatically an ego-boundary miss.
guide.GT_MASK_AMBIGUOUS: The image does not support an unambiguous mask judgment, or the GT is incomplete. Do not force a detector-failure label.
guide.INTERSECTION_OR_MERGE: An intersection, split or merge prevents simple marking association. Do not infer an ego lane.
guide.MULTI_LANE_AMBIGUOUS: Several marking structures are plausible and assignment cannot be resolved from this frame.
guide.OTHER: A cause outside the frozen labels; explain it in the comment. It prevents a resolved causal verdict.
guide.REPRESENTATION_MISMATCH: Continuous polylines versus dashed/painted masks account for the discrepancy; absence of paint between dashes is not automatically detector failure.
guide.UNRESOLVED: Evidence is insufficient. Use this for unreviewable frames; do not guess.
